name: Debate & Adversarial Review Runtime
objective: Implement a bounded debate and adversarial review runtime that allows role-specific agents to challenge plans, identify contradictions, test assumptions and produce evidence-backed objections before implementation proceeds.
why_now: P26 introduced a bounded advisory swarm. P27 must add structured debate and adversarial review so the swarm does not become a consensus machine or amplify planner bias.
must_not_create: external paid calls without explicit config
